decisive_items: moderate peripheral enhancement and central hypoenhancement
splenomegaly with a 57 × 58 mm patchy low-density lesion
response.rationale: Refractory severe thrombocytopenia with a solitary splenic mass showing peripheral enhancement and central hypoenhancement best fits littoral cell angioma; the splenic hamartoma label is only preliminary and less specific.

rejected.why: No nodal, systemic, or imaging features specifically supporting lymphoma.
Splenomegaly is a descriptive finding, not a specific diagnosis.
Thrombocytopenia is present but refractory to ITP-directed therapy and associated with a splenic mass.
Only a preliminary diagnosis; the imaging pattern and refractory thrombocytopenia better support littoral cell angioma.
